assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容组织、讨论与返修，官方几何发布后整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry is provisional.

assumptions.statement_zh: 声景设施涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护与建设控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions are unknown; concept-level only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 噪声与声级数据仅有公开口径，本方案不引用未核实数值，不编造分贝值、声级或档案数量数据。
assumptions.statement_en: No unverified noise or decibel figures are cited.

assumptions.statement_zh: 噪声监测与声景导览均以匿名聚合为边界，不进行个体识别式追踪、不建立大规模行为画像，关键决策人工复核。
assumptions.statement_en: Anonymized aggregation only; no individual-identifying tracking; human review for key decisions.

assumptions.statement_zh: 历史声音档案涉及来源与权利：本方案仅概念性建议档案登记与授权流程，声音素材均须公开来源或自采并注明权利，不使用侵权素材。
assumptions.statement_en: Sound archives require provenance and rights registration; only cleared or self-recorded sources are used.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI生成的声音档案描述与导览内容须经人工审核后发布，遵守版权与署名要求，不歪曲历史事实。
assumptions.statement_en: AI-generated soundscape descriptions require human review; no historical distortion.

assumptions.statement_zh: 六类人才画像（遗产爱好者、噪声敏感居民、声音艺术家、通勤者、学生聆听者、老年与听障居民）为设计假设，未经真实调研与社区共创验证；后续以「居民声景议事会」与共创征集补充证据。
assumptions.statement_en: The six persona groups are design hypotheses pending survey and co-creation validation.

assumptions.statement_zh: 试点默认不保留原始录音，仅保留匿名化特征；确需保留的档案素材按来源与权利登记规则单列并经口述者/权利人同意。
assumptions.statement_en: Raw recordings are not retained by default; only anonymized features, unless separately registered with consent.
